subject: general
question: Which among the following is NOT a way to acquire Citizenship of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**By Renunciation.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Renunciation** is** not** a way to acquire citizenship of India, it is a process of **giving up Indian citizenship** by a person who already possesses it.
 
• A person can renounce their Indian citizenship if they are acquiring citizenship of another country or if they no longer wish to be an Indian citizen.
 
• They need to apply for renunciation at the Indian embassy or consulate in their country of residence.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **By birth:**

 
 
• If a child is born outside India to Indian parents, they can acquire Indian citizenship by registering at the nearest **Indian embassy or consulate **within one year of their birth.
 
 
 
• **By registration:**
 
 
• A person can apply for registration as an Indian citizen if they have been living in India for **seven years **and have resided in the **country for at least one year **before submitting their application.
 
 
 
• **By naturalisation:**
 
 
• A person can apply for naturalisation as an Indian citizen if they have resided in India for at least **12 years (or 11 years** for certain categories of applicants), have been of **good character**, and have an adequate knowledge of a language specified in the **Constitution of India.**
